verification_policy: Single-skill Ki Blast Super research: reconcile canonical class, counter taxonomy, acquisition, DLC provenance, mechanics, and Ultimate Finish evidence. Unsupported fields remain null.
research_scope: Counter Impact — Ki Blast Super / counter taxonomy research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository coverage against Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation, the all-186 Parallel Quest guide, DLC documentation, and community corroboration.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No prior repository research batch for Counter Impact was found. The canonical identity is Super / Ki Blast. Counter behavior is represented through the Counter Skills taxonomy and is not promoted to a second Counter / Counter identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Counter Impact as a Ki Blast Super and Counter Skill. Its counter stance is triggered against incoming melee attacks, after which the user warps behind the opponent; holding the input extends the sequence into a Ki Wave.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Counter Impact is listed as a Basic Reward for Parallel Quest 153 — Seeing Double.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: PQ153 is part of the Conton City Vote Pack. The DLC reference lists Counter Impact among the pack's ten new skills and PQ153 among its four Parallel Quests.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required is false because the all-186 Parallel Quest guide explicitly lists Counter Impact in PQ153 Basic Reward. No reviewed source establishes a separate Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100. No reliable reviewed source establishes a stamina cost or drop probability, so those fields remain null.
verification_audit.availability_policy: The reviewed sources establish GT Vegeta as the notable/user character and identify the move as a DLC/PQ skill, but the selected evidence set does not explicitly document CaC usability as a standalone fact. usable_by_cac therefore remains null rather than being inferred.

records.name: Counter Impact
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-186 Parallel Quest guide lists Counter Impact under PQ153 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Enter a defensive stance to deflect a melee attack, then warp behind the opponent. Holding the input extends the follow-up into a Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes a brief stance followed by a warp behind the opponent. The extended input fires a Ki Wave after the warp. The reference records 100 Ki and approximately 15% damage for the Ki Wave property. The Counter Skill taxonomy classifies Counter Impact as a Ki counter, while the in-game description specifically describes deflecting melee attacks; this distinction is preserved rather than generalized into a universal-counter claim.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ153, Seeing Double, is the documented acquisition route. The quest guide lists Counter Impact among Basic Rewards. Community reports corroborate that players farm PQ153 for the skill, but do not establish a reliable drop probability.
records.pve_notes: PQ153 is the documented farming route. Basic-reward evidence means no separate Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded.
records.pvp_notes: Community discussion describes the move as a defensive teleport/vanish-like counter with an optional Ki Blast follow-up. Exact frame advantage, matchup behavior, and version-sensitive timing are not promoted to canonical fields.
